description: START HERE when you do not yet know which service to buy: this is the entry point to the catalog. Already have a service id? get_service returns that one in full detail. Know the service and only need the right plan for a quantity? recommend_service picks one. Searches the sellable social growth service catalog (Telegram, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more). Each result includes the service (id, name, platform, starting/cheapest price per 1000) AND its plan options (each with id, name, price per 1000, min/max quantity) - present the options to the user and let them choose a plan, then pass that service_option_id to get_quote and create_paid_order (this endpoint lists it while the accountless x402 payment channel is on), or create_checkout when a person will pay in their own wallet instead (listed while checkout sessions are on) instead of defaulting to the cheapest.

country.description: Filter to geo-targeted services for a country (matches the catalog's geo-target codes, e.g. a country name or code). Most services are global and unaffected.

locale.description: Catalog language for names/descriptions (default en). Each service is returned once per call in this single language.

max_price.description: Only services whose starting price per 1000 is at most this (USD) - use for a budget cap.

min_price.description: Only services whose starting price per 1000 is at least this (USD).

offset.description: Row offset for paging (default 0). The response returns total, limit, offset and returned; fetch the next page with offset += limit while offset+returned < total.

platform.description: Filter by platform key, e.g. telegram, instagram, tiktok, youtube.

quality_tier.description: Filter by quality tier, e.g. standard, premium.

query.description: Keyword search over service names and descriptions. Pass concrete keywords (e.g. "telegram members"); map the user's natural-language intent (budget, country, speed) onto the structured filters below.

sort_order.description: "asc" or "desc". Defaults to desc for newest, asc for name.

speed_tier.description: Filter by delivery speed tier (e.g. instant, fast) - use for "fastest delivery" requests.

name: search_catalog
